mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO trip_item (trip_id, seq, poi_id, start_time, end_time, cost, next_mode, next_minutes, next_meters, next_cost) VALUES
(#{it.tripId}, #{it.seq}, #{it.poiId}, #{it.startTime}, #{it.endTime}, #{it.cost}, #{it.nextMode}, #{it.nextMinutes}, #{it.nextMeters}, #{it.nextCost})
mapper.select: SELECT i.seq, i.poi_id, p.name, p.type, p.illustration, p.lng, p.lat, p.official_url, i.start_time, i.end_time, i.cost, i.next_mode, i.next_minutes, i.next_meters, i.next_cost FROM trip_item i JOIN poi p ON p.id = i.poi_id WHERE i.trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY i.seq
